name: Create a modern, premium agenc
prompt: Create a modern, premium agency website for **KARVAAN LABS**, a creative digital agency that helps brands and businesses build their online presence.  KARVAAN LABS offers:  * Website design and development * Video editing and production * Social media content creation * Social media marketing and management * Branding and digital creative services  The visual identity should be built around **purple, white, and black**, giving the brand a bold, creative, modern, and technology-driven feel.  The website should showcase KARVAAN LABS as a professional creative partner through a strong hero section, clear services presentation, featured projects, extensive proof of work, client results/testimonials, agency introduction, and a clear process explaining how projects are handled.  Include a portfolio/work section with multiple website projects, video editing examples, social media campaigns, branding work, and other creative projects. Each project should feel like a real case study with visuals, project descriptions, services provided, and results where appropriate.  Include strong calls-to-action throughout the website such as **Start a Project**, **Work With Us**, and **Get in Touch**.  The website should also include:  * About KARVAAN LABS * Services * Featured Work / Portfolio * Case Studies * Client Testimonials * Results / Achievements * Creative Process * Contact section * Social media links * Email/contact information * Footer with navigation, services, social links, contact details, and copyright information  The overall experience should communicate **creativity, reliability, premium quality, and strong execution**, while making the portfolio and proof of work the central focus of the website.

tasks.focus: Establish the bold, creative, modern, and technology-driven visual language utilizing purple, white, and black, ensuring premium typography, layout hierarchy, and immersive UI/UX aesthetics.
Design a responsive single-page web architecture with smooth navigation, modular section components, high-performance asset handling, and clean component organization.

Implement interactive case study modals/views, dynamic portfolio filtering across multiple categories (websites, video, social, branding), interactive testimonials/results sliders, and conversion-optimized call-to-action workflows.

design.theme: Bold, modern, and tech-driven creative agency aesthetic with a sleek dark foundation, striking neon purple highlights, and clean high-contrast white typography.

typography.scale: Modular scale 1.25: Hero 3.5rem/4rem, H1 2.75rem, H2 2rem, H3 1.5rem, Body 1rem, Small 0.875rem

layout: Fixed glassmorphism header with logo, navigation anchor links, and a prominent 'Start a Project' CTA button
Immersive hero section with bold headline, animated gradient background glow, value proposition, dual CTAs, and key stats ticker
Bento-grid style services presentation and portfolio case study showcase with interactive filter tabs
Multi-column footer featuring brand statement, quick navigation links, services list, social icons, and copyright notice
responsive_behavior: Desktop: Full multi-column bento grids, spacious padding, sticky header, hover micro-interactions
Tablet: 2-column grid structures, optimized font scales, collapsible menu or horizontal scrolling filters
Mobile: Single-column vertical stack, full-screen mobile menu overlay, touch-friendly tap targets (minimum 48px)
visual_style: Dark frosted glass cards (surface #14141C) with subtle 1px purple-tinted borders and soft glowing box shadows on hover
Pill-shaped primary gradient buttons with smooth hover scaling and luminous purple-to-blue glow effects
animations: Smooth CSS transitions on hover (transform translateY(-4px), border color change to accent), subtle fade-in and slide-up scroll reveals for sections

dom_structure: header#site-header (sticky navigation, logo, nav links, CTA button, mobile hamburger toggle)
section#hero (bold value proposition, primary CTAs, glowing tech-purple accents, quick metrics banner)
section#about (agency introduction, core mission, why partner with Karvaan Labs)
section#services (grid of 5 core services: web dev, video production, social content, social marketing, branding with interactive service cards)
section#process (step-by-step creative workflow from Discovery to Launch & Scaling)
section#portfolio (filterable portfolio grid: All, Web, Video, Social, Branding with case study modal triggers)
section#results (metrics counter banner: client growth, ROAS, video views, shipped projects)
section#cta-banner (high-impact call to action banner for starting projects)
section#contact (interactive contact form, direct email/phone info, social links)
footer#site-footer (comprehensive navigation links, services list, social icons, copyright)
div#case-study-modal (dynamic modal overlay for detailed case studies with visuals, description, services, and results)
div#toast-notification (floating notification for form submission success)

css_architecture.layout_strategy: CSS Grid for portfolio and services masonry/responsive grids; Flexbox for navigation, card headers, and alignment; clamp() for fluid typography across viewports.
responsive_breakpoints: Mobile: max-width 768px (hamburger menu, stacked single-column grids)

js_architecture.state_schema: const state = { activeFilter: 'all', currentModalProject: null, isMobileMenuOpen: false, formSubmitting: false };
core_functions: initApp(): initializes event listeners, portfolio rendering, and scroll observers
renderPortfolio(filter): filters and renders project cards into #portfolio-grid based on category
openCaseStudyModal(projectId): populates and displays the detailed case study modal with results and visuals
closeCaseStudyModal(): hides and resets the case study modal
handleContactSubmit(e): validates and simulates AJAX submission of the contact form with success toast
toggleMobileMenu(): handles mobile navigation drawer toggle state
event_delegation: document.addEventListener('click', handler) for portfolio filter buttons, case study triggers, modal close buttons, and mobile menu toggles
document.addEventListener('submit', handler) for contact form submission

constraints: Must be contained entirely within a single index.html file
Zero external build steps or complex bundlers required
Accessible semantic markup with proper ARIA attributes for modals and interactive elements

features.name: Navigation Bar and Smooth Scrolling
features.purpose: Provide persistent header navigation across agency sections with quick access to key pages and call-to-action buttons.
features.interaction: User clicks navigation links (Services, Work, Process, About, Testimonials, Contact) or the 'Start a Project' CTA button.
features.behavior: Window smoothly scrolls to the target section; navigation highlights active section based on scroll position.
edge_cases: Mobile view: hamburger toggle opens slide-out navigation menu.
Clicking mobile menu link automatically closes the mobile menu and scrolls to section.

features.name: Hero Section with Value Proposition and CTAs
features.purpose: Instantly capture visitor attention, communicate KARVAAN LABS' tech-driven creative expertise, and drive immediate conversions.
features.interaction: User views bold typography, tagline, and clicks 'Start a Project' or 'Explore Work'.
features.behavior: Clicking 'Start a Project' smooth-scrolls or opens the project inquiry modal/contact section; 'Explore Work' scrolls to the portfolio section.
edge_cases: Responsive reflow of dynamic tagline and CTA buttons on smaller screens.

features.name: Services Presentation Grid
features.purpose: Clearly outline the 5 core agency offerings with compelling descriptions and visual icons.
features.interaction: User hovers over service cards or clicks a service to view details or filter portfolio items.
features.behavior: Service cards elevate on hover with smooth transition effects; clicking a service card optionally filters the portfolio section.
edge_cases: Ensuring touch device tap events correctly trigger hover state or card expansion.

features.name: Featured Work and Filterable Portfolio
features.purpose: Showcase extensive proof of work covering website design, video editing, social media campaigns, branding, and digital creative services.
features.interaction: User clicks category filter tabs (All, Websites, Video, Social Media, Branding) and clicks on project cards.
features.behavior: Portfolio grid filters items dynamically with transition animations; clicking a project card opens the Case Study Modal.
edge_cases: Zero search results / empty category state displays a polite message with a reset filter button.

features.name: Real Case Study Modal / Expanded View
features.purpose: Provide deep-dive proof of work featuring visuals, project descriptions, services provided, and measurable results.
features.interaction: User clicks on any portfolio project card to open the modal and clicks close button or outside modal bounds to exit.
features.behavior: Modal overlay fades in with body scroll locked; displays project imagery/video embed, detailed write-up, tech stack/services tags, and key results metrics.
edge_cases: Escape key closes the active modal.
Handling long text content inside modal with internal vertical scrolling.

features.name: Creative Process Section
features.purpose: Demystify project execution and build trust by outlining the step-by-step agency workflow from discovery to launch.
features.interaction: User scrolls through sequential step cards or clicks steps to highlight details.
features.behavior: Numbered process steps animate into view sequentially, highlighting KARVAAN LABS' structured execution model.
edge_cases: Compact vertical stack layout on mobile viewports.

features.name: Client Results and Testimonials Carousel
features.purpose: Display social proof, achievements, client success stories, and verified testimonials.
features.interaction: User clicks Next/Prev arrow buttons or navigation dots to cycle through client testimonials and achievement stats.
features.behavior: Testimonial cards transition smoothly displaying client quotes, names, companies, and quantifiable success metrics.
edge_cases: Boundary navigation wraps around to the first/last testimonial seamlessly.

features.name: About KARVAAN LABS Agency Introduction
features.purpose: Communicate agency culture, mission, core values, and expertise in modern digital execution.
features.interaction: User reads agency story and views team/culture highlights.
features.behavior: Reveal-on-scroll animations trigger subtle fade-ins for text blocks and stat counters.

features.name: Interactive Contact Form and Inquiry Modal
features.purpose: Capture high-intent leads and project inquiries with structured input fields and instant feedback.
features.interaction: User fills in Name, Email, Service Needed, Budget Range, and Project Details, then clicks 'Send Message' / 'Work With Us'.
features.behavior: Client-side validation checks for required fields and valid email format; upon successful submission, displays a success confirmation state and resets the form.
edge_cases: Empty required fields show inline validation error highlights.
Invalid email format displays a specific error message.

features.name: Comprehensive Footer and Social Links
features.purpose: Provide secondary site navigation, direct contact details, agency social media links, and copyright information.
features.interaction: User clicks footer navigation links, social icons (LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube), or email address.
features.behavior: Social links open external profiles in a new tab; email links trigger mailto protocol.
edge_cases: Ensuring touch targets for social links and footer items are sufficiently spaced on mobile.
